descriptions.massflow.day: Get the day for the current state.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.active: Return the active state of the drawpoint. Returns true if mass is being extracted during the current period. Returns false otherwise.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.drawbell.id: Get the ID of the drawbell associated with the drawpoint dp.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.drawbell.name: Get the name of the drawbell associated with the drawpoint dp.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.extra: massflow.drawpoint.extra(dp,int>) := a Get/set the extra variable at the index associated with the drawpoint. An extra variable can be of any valid FISH parameter type.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.find: Get a pointer to the drawpoint with internally assigned ID number i. If no drawpoint exists with that ID number, then null is returned.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.group: massflow.drawpoint.group(dp,slot>) := s Get/set the group name assigned to drawpoint dp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.height: Get the height, for this drawpoint, at slice number i.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.id: Get the ID of a drawpoint.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.list: Get a pointer to the container of all drawpoints in the block model.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.mass.actual: Get the actual mass pulled for this drawpoint at DAY i.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.mass.actual.cum: Get the actual cumulative mass pulled for this drawpoint at DAY i.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.mass.requested: Get the requested mass for this drawpoint at DAY i. This comes from the input draw schedule.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.name: Get the name assigned to drawpoint dp.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.near.list: Return a fish::List of drawpoint pointers (DP_PNT) that lie strictly within a given 3D radius from the provided drawpoint.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.num: Get the total number of drawpoints in the model.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.pos: v = massflow.drawpoint.pos(dp) Get the drawpoint centroid position.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.radius: Get the radius of a given IMZ slice of a drawpoint.
descriptions.massflow.drawpoint.slices: Get a pointer to the container of all drawpoint IMZ slice radii for a given drawpoint.
descriptions.massflow.extractedmarker.birthday: Get the day at which the extracted marker was formed
descriptions.massflow.extractedmarker.disp: v = massflow.extractedmarker.disp(mm) Get the extracted marker total accumulated displacement.
descriptions.massflow.extractedmarker.extra: massflow.extractedmarker.extra(mm,int>) := a Get/set the extra variable at the index associated with the extracted marker. An extra variable can be of any valid FISH parameter type.
descriptions.massflow.extractedmarker.find: Get a pointer to the extracted marker with internally assigned ID number i. If no marker exists with that ID number, then null is returned.
descriptions.massflow.extractedmarker.fragment.diamet: Get the fragment diameter associated with this extracted marker.
descriptions.massflow.extractedmarker.group: massflow.extractedmarker.group(mm,slot>) := s Get/set the group name assigned to extracted marker mm in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.
descriptions.massflow.extractedmarker.id: Get the ID of an extracted marker.
descriptions.massflow.extractedmarker.list: Get a pointer to the container of all extracted markers in the model.
descriptions.massflow.extractedmarker.mass: Get the mass associated with this extractedmarker.
descriptions.massflow.extractedmarker.mineblock: Get a pointer to the original mineblock that contained a given extracted marker.
descriptions.massflow.extractedmarker.num: Get the total number of extracted markers in the model.
descriptions.massflow.extractedmarker.origin: Get the the position of the extracted marker at the time it was created.
descriptions.massflow.extractedmarker.type: Get the extracted marker type as an integer. The types are as follows: -2: unbulked for IMZ growth -1: unbulked for collapse 0: unbulked for rilling 1: partially bulked 2: fully bulked 3: air
descriptions.massflow.marker.above: Get the marker above in the column
descriptions.massflow.marker.active: Get the active state of a marker. A marker is considered active if it has moved vertically downward during the current period. See massflow.marker.active.tolerance.
descriptions.massflow.marker.active.tolerance: Get/set the displacement tolerance that determines whether or not a marker is considered active. A marker is considered active if it has moved vertically downward more than the tolerance during the current period. The default value is 0.
descriptions.massflow.marker.below: Get the marker below in the column
descriptions.massflow.marker.birthday: Get the day at which the marker was formed
descriptions.massflow.marker.disp: v = massflow.marker.disp(mm) Get the marker total accumulated displacement.
descriptions.massflow.marker.extra: massflow.marker.extra(mm,int>) := a Get/set the extra variable at the index associated with the marker. An extra variable can be of any valid FISH parameter type.
descriptions.massflow.marker.find: Get a pointer to the marker with internally assigned ID number i. If no marker exists with that ID number, then null is returned.
descriptions.massflow.marker.fragment.diameter: Get the fragment diameter associated with this marker.
descriptions.massflow.marker.friction: Get the friction associated with this marker.
descriptions.massflow.marker.group: massflow.marker.group(mm,slot>) := s Get/set the group name assigned to marker mm in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.
descriptions.massflow.marker.id: Get the ID of a marker.
descriptions.massflow.marker.list: Get a pointer to the container of all markers in the model.
descriptions.massflow.marker.mass: Get the mass associated with this marker.
descriptions.massflow.marker.mineblock: Get a pointer to the mineblock that contains a given marker.
descriptions.massflow.marker.num: Get the total number of markers in the model.
descriptions.massflow.marker.origin: Get the the position of the marker at the time it was created.
descriptions.massflow.marker.porosity: Get the porosity associated with this marker.
descriptions.massflow.marker.pos: v = massflow.marker.pos(mm) Get the marker position.
descriptions.massflow.marker.pos.lastperiod: Get the position of the marker at the end of the previous period.
descriptions.massflow.marker.type: Get the current marker type as an integer. The types are as follows: -2: unbulked for IMZ growth -1: unbulked for collapse 0: unbulked for rilling 1: partially bulked 2: fully bulked 3: air
descriptions.massflow.mass.DpDay: Get the mass extracted for a specific drawpoint in a specific day.
descriptions.massflow.mass.period: Get the mass extracted in a specific period.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.containing: Get the mineblock mb that contains the input position v. A null pointer is returned if no block contains the vector.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.dens.current: Get the current density of the mineblock.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.dens.insitu: Get the insitu density of the mineblock (solids density / (1 - porosity)).
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.dens.solids: Get the density of the solids component of the mineblock.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.diam.current: Get the current mean diameter of the primary fragmentation in the block
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.diam.mean: Get the mean diameter of the primary fragmentation expected in the block
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.diam.mean.dyn: massflow.mineblock.diam.mean.dyn(mb) := f Get/set the mean diameter of the primary fragmentation expected in the block
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.extra: massflow.mineblock.extra(mb,int>) := a Get/set the extra variable at the index associated with the mineblock. An extra variable can be of any valid FISH parameter type.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.find: Get a pointer to the mineblock with internally assigned ID number i. If no mineblock exists with that ID number, then null is returned.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.frag.primary.a: massflow.mineblock.frag.primary.a(mb) := f Get/Set the primary fragmentation A parameter.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.frag.primary.b: massflow.mineblock.frag.primary.b(mb) := f Get/set the primary fragmentation B parameter
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.group: massflow.mineblock.group(mb,slot>) := s Get/set the group name assigned to mineblock mb in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.id: Get the ID of a mineblock.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.installmarkers: Manually install markers into mineblock mb. The marker type to be installed is given by i. The types are as follows: -2: unbulked for IMZ growth -1: unbulked for collapse 0: unbulked for rilling 1: partially bulked 2: fully bulked 3: air Optionally, if air markers are being installed, the porosity can be specified as f (between 0 and 1). If no value is given, porosity defaults to the maximum porosit of the host mine block. The function retuirns the number of markers created.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.list: Get a pointer to the container of all mineblocks in the block model.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.marker.vol: Get the accumulated total marker volume ??
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.marker.vol.air: Get the accumulated marker air volume ??
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.marker.vol.solid: Get the accumulated marker solid volume ??
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.near.list: Get a list of IDs to the mine blocks at a distance lower than \(d\).
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.num: Get the total number of mineblocks in the model.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.num.ore: Get the number of ore properties of a mineblock.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.ore.name: Get the ore name at the i position associated with the mineblock. The ore names and numbers are determined from the imported file data. See massflow mineblock import. The total number of properties is given by massflow.mineblock.num.ore.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.ore.value: massflow.mineblock.ore.value(mb,i) := f Get/set the ore property at the i position associated with the mineblock. The property numbers are determined from the imported file data. See massflow mineblock import. The total number of properties is given by massflow.mineblock.num.ore.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.perc.k1: Get the percolation rate parameter k1. See MassFlow Theory and Background.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.perc.k2: Get the percolation rate parameter k2. See MassFlow Theory and Background.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.perc.vmr: Get the variance to mean ratio for percolation distance. See MassFlow Theory and Background.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.period: Get the period number in the draw schedule at which the block is capable of flowing.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.period.dyn: Get/Set the period number in the draw schedule at which the block is capable of flowing. This is different from massflow.mineblock.period in that it is editable. If the dynamic period is different from the non-dynamic period, then the dynamic period will be used.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.poros.current: Get the current insitu porosity of the mineblock (the porosity at the current stage of flowing).
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.poros.initial: Get the initially specified insitu porosity of the mineblock (the porosity before it starts flowing).
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.poros.max.current: Get the current maximum porosity of the mineblock (the recalculated maximum porosity at this stage of flow).
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.poros.max.initial: Get the initially specified maximum porosity of the mineblock (the porosity when material has dilated fully).
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.pos: v = massflow.mineblock.pos(mb) Get the mineblock centroid position.
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.state: Get the current state indicator for the mineblock as follows: -1: solid1: caved 2: mobilized active 3: mobilized inactive 4: air 5: extracted
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.staticdays: Get the number of days that the block has been static
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.tension.a: massflow.mineblock.tension.a(mb) := f Get/set the tensile strength A parameter
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.tension.b: massflow.mineblock.tension.b(mb) := f Get/set the tensile strength B parameter
descriptions.massflow.mineblock.ucs: Get the Unconfined Compressive Strength of the intact rock material.
descriptions.massflow.period: Get the period for the current state.
